name: Phoenix

desc:
Phoenix's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>43</color>.
When any squad member deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy, the enemy enters the Sear state for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When an enemy in the Sear state takes Anomaly DMG, the DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit, with a base CRIT Rate of 30% and CRIT DMG of <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>. If Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 155, each point above this threshold increases this effect's CRIT Rate by an additional 0.7%.
When Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery reaches 255, the CRIT Rate of Anomaly DMG dealt to enemies in the Sear state reaches its maximum.
Enemies in the Sear state take <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> of Phoenix's ATK every 8s. This DMG is considered EX Special Attack DMG.
During Combustion Attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level increases, and dealing DMG grants Pyre. Phoenix can have up to 120 Pyre.
After Combustion Attacks, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to skip the backward retreat of Special Attack: Fire Sweep and EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash, immediately following up with a rising attack.
When Phoenix takes fatal DMG, she will not be defeated and leave the field. Instead, Rebirth is triggered. The next time Phoenix enters the field through a normal switch, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist, she recovers HP equal to 50% of her Max HP. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 1,200s.
When Phoenix triggers a Perfect Block, she gains 5 Pyre. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
When Phoenix uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Wither and Bloom</color> state for 20s. Hitting an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Combustion Attack</color> or reapplying this state refreshes its duration.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Wither and Bloom</color> state, after using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare</color> is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Falling Sun</color>.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same faction:
Anomaly DMG against enemies in the <Term:1000048></Term> state gains 15% increased CRIT DMG.
name: Core Passive: Nirvana
Additional Ability: Krampus Ace

description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a quick slash, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: Quick Assist: Emergency Aid

description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
description.name: Defensive Assist: Patient Turned Doctor

description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Throws her weapon at the enemy, then recalls it and performs a slash, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Regeneration Therapy

description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to 4 attacks forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
The 3rd and 4th Basic Attacks are considered <Term:1000046>Combustion Attacks</Term>.
description.name: Basic Attack: Sever Life

description.desc:
With enough <Term:1000047></Term>, consume 90 Pyre and hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Phoenix throws her weapon, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in an area ahead.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy affected by <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers 1 instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, dealing Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute with a <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:225+20*(AvatarSkillLevel(0)-1),1,2}%</color> multiplier.
When this instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> triggers a critical hit, its CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 40%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
description.name: Basic Attack: Purifying Flame

description.desc:
If Special Attack: Fire Sweep does not trigger a Perfect Block, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Charge forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Considered a <Term:1000046></Term>.
During this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: Basic Attack: Meltdown

description.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash multiple attacks forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Considered a <Term:1000046></Term>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: Chain Attack: Last-Minute Salvation

description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Fly into the air, then dive at the enemy, consuming all of Phoenix's HP to trigger an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, then enter the Wither state, and trigger the next character's Quick Assist.
Considered a <Term:1000046></Term>.
Active attacks cannot be performed while in the Wither state.
A short while after using this skill, Soul-Searching Blaze is automatically activated after a short period. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly activate Soul-Searching Blaze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
description.name: Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection

description.desc:
Triggered when Phoenix is in the Wither state, the next time she enters the field through a normal switch, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist:
Phoenix is wreathed in flames, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to nearby enemies, which is also considered Ultimate DMG, and exiting the Wither state. She recovers all HP consumed by <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection</color>, plus an additional 10% of her Max HP.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy affected by <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers 1 instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, resolving the corresponding Attribute Anomaly at a <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:300+27*(AvatarSkillLevel(3)-1),1,2}%</color> multiplier.
When this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> effect triggers a critical hit, its CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 40%.
When Phoenix enters the field via <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Last-Minute Salvation</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection</color> while in the Wither state, the HP recovery and <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> effects described above are also triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: Soul-Searching Blaze

description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
description.name: Dodge: Drifting Sway

description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Dashes forward and slashes, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
description.name: Dash Attack: Lunge

description.desc:
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a quick slash, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: Dodge Counter: Twin Passage of Karmic Fire
Dodge Counter: Twin Passage of Karmic Fire

description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
After retreating back, quickly launch an upward slash forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During the retreat, DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
If attacked at the instant the upward slash begins, or if the slash hits an enemy flashing red or yellow, a Perfect Block is triggered, negating that instance of DMG. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
description.name: Special Attack: Fire Sweep

description.desc:
With <Term:1000049></Term>, consume 1 point of Ascension and press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
After retreating, quickly perform a powerful upward slash, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> while retreating to continue charging.
While charging, release <IconMap:Icon_Special> to perform a powerful upward slash, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When chained into from a <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000046></Term></color>, skip the retreat and immediately perform the upward slash.
DMG taken while retreating and charging is reduced by 40%.
Receiving an attack just as the upward slash begins or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill counts as a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash

description.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Quickly spin around, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies.
Receiving an attack at the moment the spin begins or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill is considered a <Term:1000046></Term>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare

description.desc:
After using EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare, and with enough Energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Rises into the air and throws her weapon, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies.
Gain 1 point of Ascension when the skill is activated. Up to 1 point of Ascension can be held.
Receiving an attack at the moment she starts rising or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill is considered a <Term:1000046></Term>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
description.name: EX Special Attack: Falling Sun

1641007.desc: <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> (Press within a certain period after using EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare)
1641007.name: EX Special Attack: Falling Sun

1641009.name: Dodge Counter: Twin Passage of Karmic Fire

strategy: Grants a chance for the whole squad's Attribute Anomaly DMG to trigger a CRIT
Triggers [Rebirth] upon taking fatal DMG, allowing re-entry into battle

1.desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Phoenix gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Ascension</color>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
The CRIT DMG of Anomaly DMG dealt to enemies in the <color=#FFFFFF>Sear</color> state is increased by an additional 25%.
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Combustion Attack</color> deals DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Pyre</color> generation efficiency increases by 15%.
1.name: Lingering Pain and Thrilling Procession

2.desc:
When Phoenix applies <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> to an enemy, its duration is increased by 2s.
Phoenix's DMG against enemies in the <color=#FFFFFF>Sear</color> state increases by 30%.
2.name: Curiosity Won't Kill the Cat

4.desc: When the Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>Soul-Searching Blaze</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Purifying Flame</color> hits an enemy affected by an Anomaly, it triggers 1 additional instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, resolving the corresponding Attribute Anomaly at a fixed 600% multiplier.
4.name: Life's End and the Heartless Wonderland

6.desc:
Phoenix ignores 15% of targets' All-Attribute RES.
When Phoenix uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare</color>, she gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Ascension</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> effects triggered by Phoenix ignore 40% of enemy DEF.
6.name: Notes From Confinement
